answer: Attestation weight is counted per network. A key is bound permanently to the /24 prefix and ASN it first appears from, so moving flags it. Each epoch credits two signatures per ASN at most; the rest collapse to zero. A cluster sharing one prefix across supposed independents has emissions frozen six epochs. 500 attestations need 250 distinct networks, and broker residential IPs cost $4 to $9 monthly, over $2,000 recurring. Tundra moss endures because a dozen species share thin soil; one clone covering the mat would let a single frost spend its pulse and leave it brittle as crystal.
